technical_and_design_decisions: Assume 'XD' refers to Spring XD, 'SI' refers to Spring Integration, and 'SHDP' refers to Spring Hadoop.
For the Spark Streaming processor (U5), implement separate modules or configurations to support both Java/Lambdas and Scala as requested.
For the Windows CI (U4), use a standard CI tool (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) to provision EC2 Windows instances and run acceptance tests.
For the Kafka upgrade (U7), backport the necessary XD-specific changes to the Spring Integration Kafka adapter before upgrading to the GA release to ensure compatibility.
Align the base framework version with the latest stable release available that supports the required features, keeping in mind the Java 17+ requirement mentioned for Spring Framework 6.0.
assumptions: The reference guide PDF is generated from source files (e.g., Asciidoctor or DocBook) where the copyright year is a variable, making the update straightforward.
The migration from 1.0 to 1.1 involves standard API changes, configuration updates, and module compatibility checks, but no major architectural rewrites.
The developer has access to the necessary cloud accounts (e.g., AWS EC2) to provision Windows images.
The existing test suite is comprehensive enough to be run on Windows to evaluate XD functionalities.
The GA releases for Kafka and SHDP are publicly available and compatible with the current XD codebase with reasonable backporting effort.

activities.activity_description: Implement migration path from version 1.0 to 1.1, including porting custom modules, updating APIs, and ensuring existing data pipelines are operational.
Create and integrate a Pig script/job sample to serve as a reference for users integrating Pig jobs in XD.
Configure and fix the XD build process to successfully build on a Windows machine, resolving any OS-specific path or script issues.

activities.activity_name: Windows Acceptance Test Coverage and CI
activities.activity_description: Provision a Windows image in EC2, run acceptance tests in that environment, and set up a CI build to automate this process.
Implement Spark Streaming as a data processor in XD, providing implementations using both Java/Lambdas and Scala to demonstrate capabilities.
Update the copyright message in the reference guide source to include 2015 and regenerate the PDF.
Backport Kafka XD changes to Spring Integration (SI) Kafka, then upgrade to the Kafka GA release, ensuring all tests pass.
Upgrade to the Spring Hadoop (SHDP) GA release, resolving any breaking changes and syncing up with the latest bits.
